name: Invest Nebraska
type: VC fund (state-backed seed fund / nonprofit venture development org)
typical_check_published: Average first check $250K, as part of a round giving 12-18 months runway
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic, tech/IP-enabled: IoT, medtech, fintech, insurtech, agtech, food tech, health software, robotics & advanced manufacturing
geographic_focus: Nebraska (must have Nebraska footprint and in-state growth plan)
how_to_approach: Contact form on site; warm intro via ecosystem (also co-invests with Nebraska Angels / NMotion)
caution: Wants early product-market fit: recurring revenue (software) or proof of concept (hardware/life science).

name: Nebraska Angels
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic
how_to_approach: Apply on site (Gust); monthly pitch meetings
caution: Expects MVP in market, users/pilots or recurring revenue, and a term sheet or lead investor in place (exceptions for medtech/agtech). NVCA-style docs only. Software cos need a technical team member.

name: NMotion powered by gener8tor
sectors_thesis: Industry- and business-model-agnostic; Great Plains high-growth startups
how_to_approach: Apply via online application (Airtable) when a cohort opens
caution: Fall 2026 application closed (deadline was May 17, 2026); 6 startups per cohort; spring 2026 cohort was paused per earlier project research. Next cohort dates not posted.

name: Maverick Venture Fund (UNO)
typical_check_published: Conflicting published figures: UNO marketing page says $1,000-$5,000; UndergradVC (citing fund page) says up to $25,000
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic
geographic_focus: Nebraska; targets UNO students and alumni
how_to_approach: Online funding application (Microsoft Form) on UNO page
caution: Primarily for UNO students/alumni; very small checks. Useful only for founders with a UNO tie.

name: AQi (Aequitas Invest)
typical_check_published: Raises of $150K-$5M; portal fee up to 6.5% of amount raised
sectors_thesis: Any sector; women-owned companies
how_to_approach: Apply on site ('Launch your campaign'); Entrepreneur dashboard
caution: Launched May 2026; SEC-registered/FINRA member (SEC File 7-483). Note: Golden Seeds will not invest in companies using Reg CF, so a Reg CF raise can close off some angel options.

name: Nelnet Ventures
typical_check_published: Avg first check shown on page but value did not load; not confirmed
sectors_thesis: Fintech, edtech, future of work, renewable energy/climate, agtech
geographic_focus: Midwest ecosystem (co-invests with Nebraska Angels, Invest Nebraska, gener8tor)
how_to_approach: Contact form on page; often via Nebraska Angels
caution: Invests beyond MVP with established revenue.

name: Grit Road Partners
typical_check_published: $250K seed checks (Fund I); Fund II is a $35M seed fund
sectors_thesis: Agtech across the ag value chain; producer problems; Midwest ag
how_to_approach: Contact via site/LinkedIn; warm intro
caution: Check size is from 2023 coverage; Fund II aims to lead more. Also GP for DIAL Ventures Fund II (agrifood studio).

name: Proven Ventures (Burlington Capital)
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic, customer-driven; B2B with ~$250K annual revenue
how_to_approach: Apply/contact via proven.ventures
caution: Limited capital left in Fund One; founders buy back equity from revenue. Not for pre-revenue founders.

name: LaunchLNK (LPED)
sectors_thesis: Scalable startups growing in Lincoln
geographic_focus: Lincoln, NE (must be located in or have Lincoln presence)
how_to_approach: Annual application (Round 1 closed Oct 16, 2026 for 2027 cohort)
caution: 6 recipients per year; 2027 cycle closed. Next window likely fall 2027 (not confirmed).

name: Omaha Capital
sectors_thesis: Enterprise software, financial infrastructure, healthcare tech, industrial & logistics; sector-agnostic for exceptional founders
how_to_approach: Email hello@omahacapfund.com
caution: Site names no team, portfolio, or check size; could not verify who runs it. Treat as unverified until a warm contact confirms.

name: M25
sectors_thesis: Tech/tech-enabled, software emphasis; finance & insurance, supply chain & industrial, healthcare IT, horizontal SaaS
geographic_focus: Midwest-headquartered companies only (includes Omaha and Lincoln)
how_to_approach: 'Pitch Us' form on site
caution: Company must be HQ'd in their Midwest map. Also runs midweststartups.com rankings.

name: Revolution - Rise of the Rest Seed Fund
sectors_thesis: Generalist; startups outside Silicon Valley, NY, Boston
how_to_approach: Contact via revolution.com; warm intro typical
caution: Invests out of its second $150M fund (per third-party sources). Often co-invests with local leads.

name: Hyde Park Venture Partners
stage: Pre-seed to Series A (first or second institutional round)
sectors_thesis: AI-first applications, software, tech-enabled services; logistics/robotics in portfolio
how_to_approach: 'Get in touch' contact page
caution: Invests from idea stage up to $2M revenue. Raised $98M fourth fund. Primary domain hydeparkvc.com failed; hydeparkvp.com worked.

name: Flyover Capital
hq: Overland Park, KS / Kansas City, MO
typical_check_published: Seed initial checks $1M-$3M; smaller pre-seed checks
sectors_thesis: AI in essential industries: healthcare, financial services & insurance, agriculture, logistics & supply chain, industrials, infrastructure
how_to_approach: 'Submit your company' form on contact page
caution: Wants evidence customers care (revenue, pilots, ROI) and founders close to the problem. Good thesis match for industry-insider founders.

name: Cultivation Capital
sectors_thesis: Life sciences/health tech, software/IT, agtech; Midwest Seed Stage strategy: fintech, healthcare, agtech
geographic_focus: St. Louis / greater Midwest for seed strategy
how_to_approach: Contact via site
caution: Multiple strategy funds; confirm which fund is actively writing seed checks.

name: Lewis & Clark Ventures
sectors_thesis: B2B software
how_to_approach: Contact page
caution: Too late-stage for most pre-accelerator grads; a later-round target.

name: Golden Seeds
hq: New York, NY (9 chapters incl. Chicago)
typical_check_published: Golden Seeds typically invests $125K-$350K in a first round; companies raising $250K-$2M, pre-money usually < $10M
sectors_thesis: B2B/B2C tech, health care, consumer
how_to_approach: Apply via Dealum; free Info Sessions and Office Hours
caution: Needs a woman in an operating C-suite role with fair equity; beta product and proof-of-concept revenue or pilots. Will NOT invest in companies using Reg CF or 506(c).

name: Pipeline Angels
typical_check_published: Each cohort member invests at least $5,000; classes of 5-10 members; community may join syndicate
sectors_thesis: Social/environmental mission encouraged; sector-agnostic
women_founder_focus: partial (women and non-binary founders strongly encouraged)
how_to_approach: Apply to Pitch Summit (virtual); spring 2027 summit Apr 17-18, 2027; interest form open, apps open January
caution: Small checks; investors are angels-in-training. Fall 2026 apps closed.

name: Portfolia
sectors_thesis: Women's health; Rising America (US emerging markets); greentech
women_founder_focus: partial (backs female- and male-led teams; prefers gender-balanced)
how_to_approach: Submit company form; monthly funding info session (2nd Thursdays)
caution: Wants a solution in market and prefers a lead investor already secured.

name: BBG Ventures
sectors_thesis: Health, work, vertical AI, consumer, fintech, climate; founders with lived experience of the problem
how_to_approach: 'Pitch Us' Typeform on site
caution: Current site emphasizes 'diverse founders' rather than women-only.

name: Female Founders Fund
sectors_thesis: Digital health, AI-first vertical software, beauty, pet, deep tech (aerospace, robotics, materials)
how_to_approach: No public pitch form found; warm intro
caution: Fortune (Oct 7, 2026) reports FFF changing strategy to get a bigger stake in AI - may shift away from first checks. Verify before outreach.

name: Women's Capital Connection (OneKC for Women)
sectors_thesis: Women-led enterprises
how_to_approach: Free consultation with equity-capital experts; email via site
caution: Site now emphasizes consultations and introductions to other networks; unclear whether it still makes direct investments. KC-region focus.

name: IFundWomen
typical_check_published: Current grants $5,000 (Startup Accelerator Grant through Nov 30, 2026; Honeycomb grant through Jan 15, 2027)
sectors_thesis: Women-owned businesses; crowdfunding, coaching
how_to_approach: Apply online; crowdfunding campaign
caution: Grant/crowdfunding, not equity VC. Small amounts.

name: Amber Grant (WomensNet)
typical_check_published: $15,000 monthly grants (Amber, Startup, category); three $75,000 year-end grants
sectors_thesis: All women-owned businesses; Nov category = STEM
how_to_approach: One online application ($ fee not checked)
caution: Grant; startup grant is for idea-phase or <$10K sales.

name: Cartier Women's Initiative
sectors_thesis: For-profit impact businesses (UN SDGs)
how_to_approach: Annual application; 2027 edition closed
caution: Needs $50K-$5M revenue, 5-250 team members, <$2M dilutive funding raised; woman founder in lead role. Not for idea-stage.

name: Ag Startup Engine
sectors_thesis: Agtech seed to consumption: animal health, robotics, precision ag, livestock automation, sustainability
how_to_approach: Monthly investor pitch meetings; email mikayla@agstartupengine.com
caution: Fund 2 has ~2 years of deployment left, 12-15 more companies (per site; page date unclear).

name: Ag Ventures Alliance
type: Farmer-member investment cooperative / angel network (Countryside Angels)
sectors_thesis: Agtech; farm trials; first customers among 300+ farmer members
how_to_approach: Direct investing application form on site
caution: Check size not published. Confirm the application form is current.

name: Bread & Butter Ventures
typical_check_published: Up to $1M initial into $1.5M-$3M rounds (Managing Partner LinkedIn, Aug 2025)
sectors_thesis: Food tech (no CPG), health tech/digital health (no FDA devices or pharma), enterprise tech/supply chain
how_to_approach: Contact hello@breadandbutterventures.com
caution: Investing from $40M Fund IV (closed Mar 2025).

name: Ironspring Ventures
sectors_thesis: Industrial supply chain: manufacturing/automation, construction, transport & logistics, alternative energy
how_to_approach: Deck submission form on Connect page
caution: Strong match for manufacturing/logistics/rail founders; stage and check not published.

name: HealthX Ventures
sectors_thesis: Digital health: access, efficiency, affordability; recurring revenue models
how_to_approach: Entrepreneurs page / submit startup
caution: Prefers founders with healthcare senior-management experience; leads priced equity rounds and usually takes a board seat.

name: American Family Ventures
hq: Madison, WI (offices Boston, Minneapolis, NY, Philadelphia)
sectors_thesis: Insurtech: all insurance lines, adjacent verticals, enabling tech
how_to_approach: Contact page
caution: Best insurtech fit; checks skew larger than pre-seed.

name: PGSA Venture Capital
type: Family-office-style real estate/investment firm with VC arm
stage: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A (case by case)
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic; emerging sectors; Midwest-focused
how_to_approach: 'Partner With Us' contact page; info@pgsa.com
caution: Not a self-described family office; a private investment firm with a venture arm. Wants post-prototype traction.

name: Momentis Family Office
sectors_thesis: Wealth mgmt/fintech & crypto, tech & AI, wellness, sports & entertainment, regenerative & real estate
how_to_approach: Email/form via site ('Connect with us')
caution: Carson family office; invests in 'conscious leaders'. Has backed pre-seed and seed deals.

name: Elkhorn Investments
sectors_thesis: Industry-agnostic
how_to_approach: Contact page on site
caution: Site copyright 2025; no stage/check or recent deals stated.

name: Woodard Investments
sectors_thesis: Applied AI (primary), healthcare, defense, AI infrastructure
how_to_approach: Submit deck on site; deals@woodardinvestments.com
caution: Recent deals 2025-2026.
